cim: The moral dimensions of artificial intelligence are left to be sorted amid its use
cim_eredeti: The moral dimensions of artificial intelligence are left to be sorted amid its use
szoveg_eredeti:
When it comes to the orchard that is artificial intelligence there is low hanging fruit and the fruit of the upper branches, which is harder to pick or isn’t ripe yet. Some of the fruit is already in a pie baking in the oven. The remainder of the harvest is, well, uncertain.

In the present debate around the dangers and risks posed by AI, the low hanging fruit has to do with the mushroom-like multiplication of data centers and how those fungi suck power, water and tranquility right out of the communities that don’t want them, didn’t ask for them and often had them foisted upon them by politicians who somehow stood to benefit.
